best_lineage.idea: Replace the slow recursive merge sort with a hybrid approach: use a fast 3-pass 11-bit LSD radix sort for large arrays (which handles random and duplicate data extremely well) and switch to insertion sort for small partitions, while also detecting already-sorted and reverse-sorted inputs to achieve O(n) on those cases.
